annotations.text:
Milestones is the last card in the care column, under Family — which is also why lineage is not in it. The card directly above already draws the cuttings; saying "2 cuttings taken" here would be the same fact twice, four pixels apart.

No icon chip on a row. A 38px tinted disc per line is what Care and History use, and here it would turn four facts into four badges — the one thing this card exists to not be.

The date leads and is right-aligned, so the days form a column instead of a ragged edge. That is the whole structural idea: Care is a state readout (fact left, figure right), History is every entry, and this is the few dates that mattered, in order. A trailing date would have made it a third run of label/value rows.

Counts became moments: not "214 waterings" but the day of the 200th, not a row of pot sizes but the day it went into its third pot. A running total is not a milestone; the day it crossed a round number is.

Three plants, three lengths. Sneeuw has two rows and still earns the card. Mos has one dated fact, so nothing renders: a card of hollow rows waiting to be filled is the locked badge, and a locked badge turns the app into a to-do list of things to make a plant do.
Nothing here branches on theme — every colour is one `light-dark()` token, so this artboard is the same markup under a different `:root`.

Same markup, 336px instead of 358. Both detail lines still set on one line at that width, which is what fixed the 80px date column: any wider and "after 214 days on the wishlist" wraps in the desktop column.

Details has lost its calendar row. It used to say "In the collection since 2 Mar 2021" — Milestones now says the same date as the first thing in the chronicle, and says what came of it.
